messages:
derek: Heads up — we've seen a spike in ECC/Xid errors in us-west-2 pool last 48h. 3 nodes drained, 2 currently flagged for flaky ECC. Need to discuss spare pool sizing before next rollout. Logs: `Xid 31, ECC corrected`

maria: @derek pulled the metrics — hard failures (drain-causing ECC/Xid) ~0.45%/month for this slice. Soft Xid (recovered) ~1.2% and noisy but usually not a drain.

sue: What's our current spare pool in the region? I thought we kept ~5%.

derek: Current us-west-2 spare pool = 20 GPUs (~4% of active ~500 GPUs). Drained 3 -> immediate capacity loss ~0.6%.

maria: Quick calc: active=500, p=0.0045 => expected failures = 500*0.0045 = 2.25 GPUs/month. To be conservative for bursts use Poisson approx: lam=2.25, 3-sigma ~ sqrt(lam)*3 ≈ 4.5. So provision ≈ 2.25+4.5 ≈ 6.75 → round up to 7 cold spares.

wayne: Also remember correlation risk — power/maintenance events can produce multi-GPU failures in a rack. Suggest adding a rack-level buffer of +2 where applicable.

sue: So proposal = baseline 7 spares + 2 rack buffer for hot zones. What's the monthly cost delta?

maria: Back-of-envelope: spare GPU amortized cost ≈ $1.2k/mo. 9 extra → ~ $10.8k/mo for us-west-2. Option: invest in faster reprovision (MTTR) — reduce MTTReplace from 1.5h → 30m which reduces required spares.

derek: Immediate triage plan: (1) mark the 2 flaky nodes for hardware replacement; (2) move non-critical Dedicated workloads to eu-west as temporary relief; (3) increase spare pool by +5 GPUs this week to cover observed spike.

infra-bot: AUTO-ALERT: node-gpu-482 drained due to repeated Xid 31 — ticket #INC-4982 created.

maria: I'll run a 90-day rolling failure-rate calc and open a PR to the capacity model with new params `regional_spare_buffer=7` and `rack_correlation_buffer=2`. Will also include a sensitivity test for degradation during maintenance windows.

derek: @maria @sue please loop in sales/customers owning Dedicated to allow temporary migration. I'll update the runbook `gpu/failure-triage.md` with a checklist: drain → replace → reimage → smoke-test.

sue: ack. After stabilization we should dial down alerts for soft Xid (1.2%) so SRE noise drops.

wayne: ping @eng-sre — can you check if last week's UPS maintenance overlaps with event timestamps? Could explain rack correlation.

derek: Thanks all. Action items recap: maria PR to capacity model + 90d calc, wayne check UPS correlation, infra orders replacements, ops increases spares by 5 this week. :thumbsup:
